name: read_resource
description: Read local text, list a directory, view an image, or attach a complete file.

location.description: Absolute host path, local file URI, or `result.uri` from an earlier read. Use an HTTP(S) image URL with the image view. Omit to list the startup directory.

view.description: The default view previews local media with a URI and a suggested view.

anyOf.description: Read a window. Offsets and limits count UTF-8 bytes for text and entries for directory listings.

limit.description: Requested page size. Omit to let the reader choose.

metadata.description: Include modification times and regular-file sizes in directory listings when available.

anyOf.description: The image view opens a local image or an image at a URL. The URL can come from a local file. The file view sends the whole local file to the model service for parsing, which may incur a charge.
